This step sets the tax lines of shipping methods and line items in a cart.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/core_flows/Cart/Steps_Cart/functions/core_flows.Cart.Steps_Cart.retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::
